briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Colossus cluster accelerate AGI timelines as compute arms race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple reasoning models this month while regulatory pressure mounts on export controls. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability across deployed agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4-preview with 4x reasoning depth; xAI launched Grok-4 on 300k H100 cluster; DeepSeek-V4 matched o3 performance at 60% cost. Meta's Llama-4-405B open weights triggered immediate forks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: CISA issued new guidance on agentic systems while red-team reports show persistent jailbreaks. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Oracle-Microsoft Stargate Phase 2 added 50k Blackwell GPUs; TSMC Arizona fab reached 3nm yield targets ahead of schedule for custom ASICs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10^26 FLOP training run trigger an intelligence explosion before 2028 safety standards are ratified?
